nodes.description: Germline defects centered on BMPR2 and related pathway components reduce protective BMP/TGF-beta signaling in pulmonary vascular cells, creating the upstream disease trigger for HPAH. Five of this entry's genes act within this axis and are bound here: BMPR2 as the type II receptor, GDF2 as a BMP ligand gene, SMAD9 as a downstream transcriptional effector, and ACVRL1 and ENG as the ALK1/endoglin receptor pair. A germline lesion at any of these steps lowers pathway output at this node.
